entry.name: jit.gl.light
entry.digest: Place a light source in a 3D scene
entry.description: Contains the properties needed to define a light source in OpenGL. These include light type (directional, point and spot), light color, attenuation, and spot angle and falloff. In addition a position (for point and spot) and orientation (for directional and spot) can be defined for a virtual light in 3D space.

attributes.name: ambient
attributes.digest: Ambient light setting
attributes.description: The color and opacity of the ambient light component in the form red green blue opacity (default = 0. 0. 0. 1. (opaque black)) All values should be in the range 0.-1.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: atten_const
attributes.digest: Attenuation constant
attributes.description: The constant factor in the attenuation formula: 1.0 means never attenuate, 0.0 is complete attenuation. The attenuation parameters determine how the light source diminishes with distance forandlights.

attributes.name: atten_linear
attributes.digest: Attenuation linear factor
attributes.description: The linear factor in the attenuation formula: 1 means attenuate evenly over the distance. The attenuation parameters determine how the light source diminishes with distance forandlights.

attributes.name: atten_quad
attributes.digest: Attenuation quadratic factor
attributes.description: The quadratic factor in the attenuation formula: adds a curvature to the attenuation formula. The attenuation parameters determine how the light source diminishes with distance forandlights.

attributes.name: layer
attributes.digest: Light layer ordering
attributes.description: The light layer controls the ordering of lights in GLSL lighting arrays (default = 0). With the gl2 engine, lights are accessed via the gl_LightSource array. Objects in the same layer have indeterminate ordering.

attributes.name: lookat
attributes.digest: Orientation (point-at)
attributes.description: One way to set the orientation. The light will orient so that it's local Z points to the 3D position provided. (default = 0 0 0)

attributes.name: shadowblur
attributes.digest: Shadow blur amount
attributes.description: Shadow blur amount (default = 0.2). Indicates the width of a gaussian blur performed on the shadow output texture.

attributes.name: shadowquality
attributes.digest: Shadow quality
attributes.description: Shadow texture quality (default = med). Setting this value affects theandof the internalshadow target.

attributes.name: shadowrange
attributes.digest: Shadow range
attributes.description: Shadow range value (default = 50.0). For directional lights, this represents the the maximum distance a shadow-caster can be from shadow-receiver. For spot/point lights the maximum range a light will affect other objects. Setting this as low as possible in the scene generally gives better shadow results.

attributes.name: shadows
attributes.digest: Enable shadows
attributes.description: Enable shadow casting from this light (default = 0).

attributes.name: shadowtexoutname
attributes.digest: Shadow texture output name
attributes.description: The internal shadow texture output name.

attributes.name: specular
attributes.digest: Specular light setting
attributes.description: Color and opacity of specular light component (default = 1. 1. 1. 1. (opaque white)) The first three floats in the range 0.-1. specify the RGB components of the specular light color. The fourth float (also in the range 0.-1.) specifies opacity.

attributes.name: spot_angle
attributes.digest: Spot cone angle
attributes.description: Defines the cone angle for spot type lights (default = 90)

attributes.name: spot_falloff
attributes.digest: Spot falloff
attributes.description: Defines the rate of falloff of the light from the center, to the edges of the cone (default = 0). Only applies to spot type lights.

attributes.digest: Light casting type (default = directional)

choices.digest: Models a positional source illuminating in all directions
choices.label: Point lights ignore rotation andattributes. Attenuation attributes (,, and) affect intensity.

choices.digest: Models an infinitely far away light with parallel rays (e.g. the sun)
choices.label: Directional lights ignoreand attenuation attributes.

choices.digest: Models a positional source illuminating in a specific direction
choices.label: Cone shape is determined bywith a falloff determined by. Attenuation attributes (,, and) affect intensity.

choices.label: Hemisphere lights are similar to directional but the light is cast from both above (sky), and below (ground). Sky color is set fromand ground fromcolor attributes. Hemisphere lights ignoreand attenuation attributes.
